T: Raw eggs for Rocky. Something better for you.
D: A small-time Philadelphia boxer gets a shot at the world heavyweight title.
P: Serve the mains when Rocky runs up the museum steps.
S: Shaved rib eye and melted provolone in mini rolls
Rib eye frozen 30 minutes, shaved thin, seared on a hot plate with onions, provolone melted over, piled into mini rolls.
Salami, prosciutto, provolone, artichokes, olives and roasted peppers, crusty bread
Salami, prosciutto, provolone, marinated artichoke, olives and roasted capsicum on a board with crusty bread.
Philly soft pretzels with beer cheese

Chewy figure-eight pretzels dipped in hot bicarb water, baked deep brown with rock salt, served with yellow mustard and a sharp cheddar beer cheese dip. Mix 500g plain flour, 7g yeast, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 320ml warm water, knead 8 minutes and prove 1 hour. Roll 8 ropes and twist into figure eights. Dip each for 30 seconds in 2L simmering water with 80g bicarb soda, sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour, 150ml lager and 200g grated cheddar until smooth.
M: the turkey Paulie throws out the back door

Brined turkey breast roasted golden and sliced thick, with sage and onion stuffing, cranberry sauce and a rich pan gravy. Keep it on the table. Brine a 1.5kg turkey breast overnight in 2L water with 100g salt and 50g sugar. Pat dry, rub with 40g butter and roast at 170C to 70C inside, about 80 minutes, then rest 15 minutes. Mix 200g torn bread with a sauteed onion, 40g butter, sage and an egg and bake 30 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp flour into the tray juices, add 400ml chicken stock and simmer for gravy. Serve with cranberry sauce.
Cast iron seared sirloin basted in garlic thyme butter, with roast potatoes
Sirloin dry-brined overnight, seasoned with cracked pepper, seared in a smoking cast iron pan, flipped every minute, basted with butter, garlic and thyme, pulled at 54C and rested. Roast potatoes.
W: Toasted pecans with caramel and dark chocolate, shaped like little turtles
Little clusters of toasted pecans topped with a spoon of soft caramel and a cap of melted dark chocolate, set on baking paper so each one looks like a turtle.
K: Banana, milk, peanut butter and oats blended thick, no raw eggs
A ripe banana, cold milk, a big spoon of peanut butter, oats and a little honey blended thick. Rocky's raw egg version not recommended.

d.note: For after the 4 a.m. run up the steps.

dishes.make_ahead: Freeze and shave the steak up to 1 day ahead and keep covered in the fridge; sear and build on the night

steps.text: Freeze the steak for 30 minutes so it firms up, then shave as thin as you can.
Sear the onion on a hot plate in oil until soft, then push aside and sear the beef quickly.
Lay the provolone over the meat to melt.
Split the rolls and pile the filling in.

veg.make_ahead: Slice the mushrooms and onion up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; sear and build on the night

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms and onion thin.
Sear the onion on a hot plate in oil until soft, then push aside and sear the mushrooms hard until browned. Season with salt and pepper.
Lay the cheese over the mushrooms to melt.
Split the rolls and pile the filling in.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, cover and keep chilled

steps.text: Drain the artichokes, olives and capsicum.
Arrange the salami, prosciutto and sliced provolone on a board with the jar items.
Serve with the loaf torn into pieces.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, cover and keep chilled

steps.text: Drain the artichokes, olives, capsicum, eggplant and mushrooms.
Arrange the vegetables and sliced cheese on a board with the olives.
Serve with the loaf torn into pieces.

dishes.make_ahead: Salt the steaks the night before

steps.text: Dry-brine the steaks with salt, uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Cut the potatoes into chunks, toss in oil and roast at 220C until crisp.
Season the steaks with cracked pepper. Sear in a smoking cast iron pan, flipping every minute.
Add the butter, garlic and thyme and baste until the steaks reach 54C inside.
Rest the steaks before serving with the potatoes.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the cauliflower steaks up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; roast the potatoes, sear and baste on the night

steps.text: Cut two 3cm thick steaks from the middle of each cauliflower and season with salt and the cracked pepper.
Cut the potatoes into chunks, toss in 2 tbsp of the oil and salt and roast at 220C until crisp.
Sear the cauliflower in the rest of the oil in a smoking cast iron pan for 4 minutes a side.
Add the butter, garlic and thyme, baste, then finish in the oven for 10 minutes until tender.
Serve the steaks with the potatoes and the pan butter.

dishes.make_ahead: Keeps 3 days in an airtight tin

steps.text: Toast the pecans in a dry pan and arrange in clusters of four on baking paper.
Melt the caramels with the cream and spoon over each cluster.
Melt the chocolate and spoon over the top.
Set in the fridge until firm.

dishes.make_ahead: Best blended just before drinking, as it thins out on standing

steps.text: Blend the ripe bananas, full cream milk, peanut butter, rolled oats and honey until thick and smooth.
Pour into four glasses. Skip the raw eggs, Rocky.

s.note: Shaved rib eye and melted provolone in mini rolls
s.how: Freeze a 400g rib eye for 30 minutes and shave thin. Sear on a hot plate with a sliced onion. Lay over 6 slices provolone to melt, then pile into 12 mini rolls.

s.note: Salami, prosciutto, provolone, artichokes, olives and roasted peppers, crusty bread
s.how: Arrange 100g salami, 100g prosciutto and 150g provolone on a board. Add a jar of drained artichoke hearts, olives and roasted capsicum. Serve with a crusty loaf torn into pieces.

m.note: Cast iron seared sirloin basted in garlic thyme butter, with roast potatoes
m.how: Dry-brine 4 sirloins overnight and season with cracked pepper. Sear in a smoking cast iron pan, flipping every minute. Baste with 40g butter, garlic and thyme and pull at 54C. Rest and serve with 1kg roast potatoes.

w.note: Toasted pecans with caramel and dark chocolate, shaped like little turtles
w.how: Toast 150g pecans and arrange in clusters of 4 on baking paper. Melt 200g caramels with 2 tbsp cream and spoon onto each cluster. Top with 100g melted dark chocolate and set.

d.note: Banana, milk, peanut butter and oats blended thick, no raw eggs
d.how: Blend 2 ripe bananas, 800ml cold milk, 2 tbsp peanut butter, 40g oats and a spoon of honey until thick. Pour into four glasses. Skip the raw eggs, Rocky.
